other.bow: one wear per valid fired shot; no loss if not fired
other.fishingRod: one durability per cast, not per tension frame
other.torch: one durability per active game-time illumination interval (time interval defined to ensure enough cave exploration, not per rendered frame)

breakHandling.atZero: tool unusable but remains in inventory; can be repaired, replaced or dismantled
breakHandling.cannotSoftlock: stone tools can always be recrafted from renewable materials

repair.earlyStoneTools: recraft or repair with 1 stone + 1 branch at workbench (not a new recipe; action context)
repair.metalTools: repair kit + 1 matching metal bar at workbench

weatherWear: none beyond ordinary valid action cost; weather itself does not passively break equipment
save: per instance durability and unique instance uid, queue repair is atomic
